activity.role: General and commander in Habsburg service
activity.notes: The Belvedere's institutional chronology records Prince Eugene joining Emperor Leopold I's army in 1683, later becoming Imperial Field Marshal and commander-in-chief, and at age seventy taking command of the Rhine army in 1734. ATLAS ends this representative military rail at that documented final command rather than extending it to his 1736 death.

sources.title: Belvedere Museum Vienna — History and Architecture: Prince Eugene chronology
sources.citation_text: The Belvedere chronology records Eugene entering Emperor Leopold I's army in 1683 and assuming command of the Rhine army in the War of the Polish Succession in 1734.
